# embody

> Generate templated objects


## Pages in this subsection

- [embody](embody.html.md): Generate templated objects with advanced structural embodiment features.
- [embody.base](embody.base.html.md): Core classes for embody: Context, Template, and Embodier.
- [embody.graphviz_template](embody.graphviz_template.html.md): Graphviz templates
- [embody.mappings](embody.mappings.html.md): Mapping interface wrappers for embodied objects.
- [embody.naming](embody.naming.html.md): This module is about generating, validating, and operating on (parametrized) fields
- [embody.paths](embody.paths.html.md): Path addressing for nested data structures.
- [embody.strategies](embody.strategies.html.md): Traversal strategies for template embodiment.
- [embody.substitution](embody.substitution.html.md): Pattern matching and type-preserving substitution logic for templates.
- [embody.templater](embody.templater.html.md): Base objects for definding templates
- [embody.templating](embody.templating.html.md): Making templates for various objects
- [embody.util](embody.util.html.md): Utility functions for embody: flattening, unflattening, and cycle detection.
